title: A finite forbidden family with superlinear surplus and non-join extremal graphs
summary: We give a common counterexample to two product-structure conjectures in extremal graph theory. More precisely, we construct a fixed nonempty finite family $\mathcal L$ with $p(\mathcal L)=2$ such that, for some $c>0$, \[ \operatorname{ex}(n,\mathcal L)>t_2(n)+cn^{3/2} \] for every sufficiently large $n$. Nevertheless, at every such order there is an $\mathcal L$-extremal graph whose complement is connected and which therefore admits no decomposition as a join of two nonempty graphs.
